To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the number of differentiable functions from a manifold M with boundary to a manifold N is finite if the dimensions of M and N are both finite, (2) the number of continuous functions from M to N is infinite if the dimensions of both manifolds are infinite, and (3) the number of homeomorphic manifolds is infinite if either M or N has infinite dimension.
